text:
Alice Nguyen: quick sync — we need to decide launch criteria for the micro-bundle + overage-forgiveness pilot. happy to huddle 10m but dropping notes here first.
Ben Rivera: +1. can we list must-haves vs nice-to-haves before we commit to engineering sprint?
Carmen Soto: must-have: clear billing behaviour in portal and API, including how softcaps show up. customers reported confusion last quarter.
Dinesh Patel: must-have: fallback routing policy defined when priority-lane is exhausted (we can't promise 0 errors). recommend automatic degrade to standard lane + email notification.
Emma Li: must-have: telemetry for per-customer spike shape (latency, tokens/second) and cost delta. we need this to evaluate economic impact of forgiveness.
Ben Rivera: nice-to-have: admin toggle for forgiveness window (e.g., 24h vs 7d) in console. could be v1 soft-launch with defaults first.
Alice Nguyen: launch checklist proposal: 1) product docs + quickstart 2) billing flows: UI + invoice line item 3) alerting and SLOs 4) pilot contract template 5) rollback plan 6) on-call runbook. thoughts?
Carmen Soto: add: explicit customer communication templates for enabled pilots (so CS knows what to say).
Dinesh Patel: engineering constraints: implementing forgiveness requires changes to metering pipeline + billing export. estimate: 3w infra + 1w front-end + 1w QA. can trim if we scope no-admin-toggle.
Emma Li: data ops: we'll need a way to tag pilot customers to opt into forgiveness; prefer a tenant flag at the routing layer. also need an eval dashboard to compare billed vs theoretical.
Ben Rivera: pricing angle: micro-bundle (small guaranteed commit + priority lane) + forgiveness as an addon. how to express on invoice? line items: "MicroBundle — priority (commit)" and "Overage Forgiveness (pilot)"
Alice Nguyen: contract constraints: pilot must include max forgiveness cap (e.g., up to $X or Y% of monthly spend) and terminate after one billing cycle unless extended. legal ok with that?
Carmen Soto: legal flagged: need explicit language about non-accumulative forgiveness and no SLA change. i'll draft clause.
Dinesh Patel: technical risk: if we retroactively credit invoices, downstream finance systems must accept adjustments. confirm with finance before launch.
Ben Rivera: can finance accept credits as separate invoice lines rather than adjustments? avoids hitting closed-month accounting.
Emma Li: analytics: we should compute projected impact on unit economics per tier. micro-bundle buyers skew to higher burstiness — forgiveness may cost more on sample customers. need sample size >= 5 customers to be meaningful.
Alice Nguyen: pilot rollout plan idea: 1) internal canary (3 customers selected by SEs) 2) invite-only pilot (15 customers) 3) public opt-in with caps. only promote in marketing after success metrics met.
product-bot: Reminder: please tag pilot customers in the CRM and set "pilot_status=forgiveness_v1".
Ben Rivera: success metrics for pilot: - <=10% of pilot customers request manual invoice adjustments - forgiveness cost as % of pilot revenue <= predefined threshold - no customer-facing latency regressions due to routing changes
Carmen Soto: launch gating: docs + contract + billing flow + monitoringhooks ✅; engineering must provide deploy window and rollback within 2 hours.
Dinesh Patel: ops ask: require a feature-flag roll out and ability to disable per-tenant in <5 minutes. Can do if we scope the flag to routing+metering only.
Emma Li: add to telemetry: a daily digest email for pilot owners summarizing credits issued and top offenders. helps rapid iteration.
Alice Nguyen: timeline suggestion: freeze scope by EOD Friday, engineering intake next Mon, tentative pilot deploy in 5 weeks.
Ben Rivera: ok from biz side if Carmen legal and finance sign off by next Thu.
Carmen Soto: i'll start contract draft today and loop in finance.
Dinesh Patel: i'll get eng estimate refined and post PRD link here.
Emma Li: i'll assemble sample customers and telemetry dashboard spec.
Alice Nguyen: great — action items: Carmen contract, Dinesh eng estimate + rollout plan, Emma telemetry + sample list, Ben pricing lines + pilot commercial note. Follow-up thread after intake. :thumbsup:
Ben Rivera: thanks — ping if anything blocks.
